subject: KIP status: reproduction done, transfer gap on finite networks
body:
Hi Dmitri, Bao,

Status. Reproduction milestone closed May 26: we regenerate distilled sets with the infinitely-wide ConvNet kernels and match the released numbers within 0.3% test accuracy. The Label Solve variant is also wired in — it's much cheaper when we only re-solve labels on a fixed support set, which is likely the mode platform users actually want.

The honest caveat: the kernel-to-finite-network transfer gap. Training a finite ConvNet on a distilled set (per the release's nn_training flow) costs us 4-6% accuracy versus the kernel regime, and on our internal tabular corpus the early gap is nearer 8%. For CI-loop use that's fine; for the data-minimization pitch it needs to be front and center in the quality-delta doc.

On track for Jun 19 on the internal corpus. Chiara's artifact schema went to Jun's team for review last week — no response yet, gentle nudge needed given the freeze.

Kaia
